programme.title: Destiny
programme.desc: The development of science and the emergence of time travel provide a chance to avoid the largest bomb attack in history.The explosion had occurred in New York ten years earlier.The risky task is undertaken by a secret government agency headed by Robertson.He realizes the danger.Since any interference with past events can irreversibly change the present, he develops a plan to eliminate the terrorist without side effects.He chooses a random agent to carry out the mission.He is to recruit a younger version of the criminal into his organization.At the same time, he makes surprising discoveries about himself.

programme.title: 30 days of darkness
programme.desc: The town of Barrow, Alaska, goes dark for thirty days every year.Most residents leave their homes at this time.The safety of those who decided to stay is ensured by young sheriff Eben Olsen (Josh Hartnett).He is struggling with serious personal problems.His marriage with Stella (Melissa George) is in crisis and she wants to leave him.Soon, however, they must unite their forces and fight the vampires who attack a town cut off from the world and plunged in darkness.Hungry monsters launch a bloody hunt for people imprisoned in Barrow.Eben, Stella and a handful of survivors begin their fight for survival.They do everything to wait for the end of the polar night.Adapted from a comic book by Steve Niles and Ben Templesmith.

programme.title: This is the end
programme.desc: A series of paranormal events take place in Los Angeles, reminiscent of the end of the world.As a result of the chaos in the city, a group of friends are trapped in an apartment.Unfortunately, their situation is becoming more and more dramatic by the minute: they are running out of food and free space, which gives rise to conflicts.Finally, having no other choice, they decide to leave the apartment and face the chaos outside.The wacky comedy is the directorial debut of two comedians: Seth Rogen and Evan Goldberg.In addition to brilliant humor, the film is full of fierce irony directed at American celebrities.The main roles were played by: James Franco ("Citizen Milk", "127 Hours"), Jonah Hill ("Moneyball", "The Wolf of Wall Street"), Danny McBride ("Divine Chillout", the series "It Could Be Worse"), Emma Watson ("Harry Potter") and singer Rihanna.

programme.title: The Inventor
programme.desc: The brilliant inventor Leonardo da Vinci cannot satisfy his enormous curiosity about the world.In search of inspiration, he leaves Italy and lives at the French court, where he can freely experiment by inventing flying machines, amazing vehicles and examining the human body.He comes up with the idea of ​​​​creating an ideal city and, together with the adventurous and bold Princess Margaret, tries to convince the ruler of his vision.Together they are also looking for answers about the meaning of life.However, the king expects something down-to-earth from the artist and researcher - he wants a large statue to show the world his power.

programme.title: Legend of the Boneknapper Dragon
programme.desc: Gobber is convinced that the legendary dragon Gnatochrup is behind the burning of his house.When none of the neighbors want to believe in the existence of the beast, the old Viking decides to hunt the dragon that is stalking him.He is joined by Hiccup and friends to ensure Gobber's safe return.During the sea journey, they listen to more and more unbelievable stories about the rivalry between a Viking and a monster.Eventually, the travelers crash on Dragon Island, where they learn the truth about Gnatochrup.The animation is a continuation of the film "How to Train Your Dragon".In the Polish language version, the characters were voiced by, among others:Tomasz Traczyński, Mateusz Narloch, Grzegorz Drojewski and Julia Kamińska.

programme.title: Completement cramé
programme.desc: A widowed, wealthy Englishman, Andrew Blake (John Malkovich), goes to France, the homeland of his beloved wife.When he arrives at the stately mansion with a suitcase, to his surprise he is not mistaken for a guest, but a candidate for a butler.To stay as long as possible in the place where he met the love of his life years ago, he accepts a job offer and does not reveal the real destination of his trip to anyone.He meets the owner of the historic mansion, the widow Nathalie Beauvillier (Fanny Ardant), the housekeeper and cook Odile (Émilie Dequenne), the maid Manon (Eugénie Anselin) and the estate manager Philippe.Over time, he becomes friends with the residents and helps them look at their lives from a different perspective.Thanks to this, he also finds his lost joy and motivation to act.

programme.title: La grazia
programme.desc: The President of Italy (Toni Servillo) is at the end of his term.In six months, his political and social role will come to an end.At this time, the head of state faces moral dilemmas caused by the euthanasia regulations and the issue of pardoning two life sentences.Every decision will expose the politician to criticism, but it is up to him to decide which crime deserves forgiveness: an act of mercy or murder.Bending under the weight of responsibility, the statesman tries to buy time.At the same time, he struggles with personal problems.Despite the passage of 40 years, he still has not forgiven his deceased wife's betrayal, and he cannot find the way to his daughter (Anna Ferzetti).Ultimately, however, it proves that even if you know yourself perfectly, you can make a decision that will surprise everyone and bring inner freedom.

programme.title: BlacKkKlansman
programme.desc: Early 1970s, Colorado Springs, Colorado.Ron Stallworth (John David Washington) becomes the first black police officer in the department.After encountering manifestations of racism, he asks to be transferred to undercover work.He decides to infiltrate the Ku Klux Klan, but for this he will need the help of an older, white colleague - Flip Zimmerman (Adam Driver).Ron calls representatives of a racist militia on the phone, and Flip meets with them directly.The police obtain information about the Klan's planned attack.Ron contacts David Duke (Topher Grace), the Grand Wizard of the Ku Klux Klan, by phone.Soon, Flip is accepted into the organization.Spike Lee's film won an Oscar for best adapted screenplay in 2019.Starring: versatile supporting actor Adam Driver ("What's Up, Davis?", "Silence") and former American football player John David Washington, Denzel Washington's son, nominated for a Golden Globe for this role.

credits.actor: Master Patrolman Andy Landers - Frederick Weller

programme.title: Macbeth
programme.desc: Macbeth returns from his war expedition.The witches predict a wonderful future for him.The man's ambition and lust for power awaken, additionally fueled by his wife.However, his path to the throne will be bloody.

programme.title: Bohemian Rhapsody
programme.desc: London, 1970.Farrokh "Freddie" Bulsara (Rami Malek) works at Heathrow Airport.One day he meets Mary Austin (Lucy Boynton), who becomes his girlfriend.He also meets members of the band Smile - drummer Roger Taylor (Ben Hardy) and guitarist Brian May (Gwilym Lee).The musicians are looking for a new vocalist.It becomes Freddie.Additionally, bassist John Deacon (Joe Mazzello) joins the group.Some time later they record their debut album.Soon, Freddie changes the band's name to Queen and his surname to Mercury.The artists come under the wing of manager John Reid (Aidan Gillen) and release a new album, and then go on tour around the United States.Even though Freddie proposes to Mary, during the trip he begins to question his own sexuality.In 1975, the album "A Night at the Opera" was released, which included, among others:the song "Bohemian Rhapsody".The composition becomes the reason for the breakup with the current manager, but also makes the musicians real stars.

programme.title: Tripped Up
programme.desc: Lizzy (Leah Lewis) has always dreamed of becoming a chef.However, participating in a culinary reality show and later working in a New York restaurant became a source of frustration for her.A cooking enthusiast is one step away from giving up her greatest passion.The last chance to stay in the catering industry is to participate in a culinary festival.Together with her friends, Mary (Ashley Moore), Kai (Ariel Winter) and Taylor (Sasha Fox), she sets off on an adventure.If she fails, she is ready to look for another path in life.Unfortunately, the team has been plagued by bad luck since the beginning of the expedition.

programme.title: 4 from there
programme.desc: Another installment of the adventures of people living in a town straight from a nightmare.It is a terrifying place that traps anyone who crosses its borders.Desperate residents fight to stay alive.

programme.title: Half Man
programme.desc: 1980s. The life of bullied teenage Niall (Mitchell Robertson) turns upside down when the son of his mother's partner, the fierce and unpredictable Ruben (Stuart Campbell), comes to live with them for a while.Even though they are not related by blood, over time they both become inseparable.However, subsequent events make them move away from each other.Three decades later, Ruben (Richard Gadd) shows up uninvited at Niall's (Jamie Bell) wedding.It soon becomes clear why he reconnected with his long-lost brother.A suggestive story about the fragility of male relationships, brotherhood, betrayal, loyalty and violence.

programme.title: House of the Dragon 2
programme.desc: The second series of the production, the events of which precede the action of "Game of Thrones".After the death of Lucerys Velaryon, the son of Queen Rhaenyra Targaryen (Emma D'Arcy), which was caused by his cousin, Aemond Targaryen (Ewan Mitchell), Westeros finds itself on the brink of a bloody civil war.The Green Council supporting King Aegon (Tom Glynn-Carney) and Queen Rhaenyra's Black Council are fighting for influence.Each side claims the Iron Throne.The dynamic development of events also affects the attitude of Rhaenyra's husband, Daemon (Matt Smith), in life.A man who spends a lot of time in Harrenhal Castle, away from his wife, changes a lot.In addition, the demons of his past begin to haunt him.

credits.actor: King Aegon II Targaryen - Tom Glynn-Carney
Lord Corlys 'The Sea Snake' Velaryon - Steve Toussaint

programme.title: Guy Ritchie's the Covenant
programme.desc: March 2018.There is a war in Afghanistan.Master Sergeant John Kinley (Jake Gyllenhaal) and his unit are ambushed by the Taliban during a routine vehicle inspection.The American translator dies in it.He will be replaced by Ahmed Abdullah (Dar Salim).During a secret mission, Kinley learns that his new associate had previous ties to the Taliban.He escaped when the organization murdered his son.Over time, an alliance develops between him and the American soldier.Ahmed saves John, who after some time gains the opportunity to repay his debt.

credits.actor: Master Sergeant John Kinley - Jake Gyllenhaal

programme.title: Sanctuary
programme.desc: Hal Porterfield (Christopher Abbott) orders room service at a posh hotel.Rebecca Marin (Margaret Qualley) shows up at the apartment to interview him for the position of general manager of this chain of facilities.Her questions become more and more personal and lead to a surprising ending.In reality, the woman is a dominatrix who follows the script prepared by Hal.However, the relationship does not follow the script ordered by the client.The woman decides to blackmail the rich man.She claims that she recorded a compromising sex tape with him.

credits.actor: Man in the Hallway - Francisco Castaneda
Woman in the Hallway - Kathie Young

programme.title: Locke
programme.desc: Ivan Locke (Tom Hardy) is one of the best civil engineers in England.He has just finished working on a construction site in Birmingham and is driving to London, where he lives.Tomorrow is the most important day of his career so far, and it is related to the project of a gigantic apartment building.While traveling home, Ivan receives one phone call that completely changes his life... Tom Hardy and Steven Knight had already met during the production of the second season of the series about English gangs of the 1920s, entitled"Peaky Blinders".Hardy played the boss of a Jewish gang, Alfie Salomons, and Knight co-wrote the script.

programme.title: Quitter la nuit
programme.desc: Belgium.Emergency line operator Anna (Veerle Baetens) receives a call from a woman who has apparently made a mistake.After a while, however, he realizes that she is pretending to talk to her sister in order to confuse the driver of the car she is sitting in.When the car is soon stopped by the police, the passenger, Aly (Selma Alaoui), accuses the driver, Dary (Guillaume Duhesme), of rape.Although the man denies it, he is arrested.The investigation begins.The following weeks pass, during which law enforcement agencies look for evidence, the injured party tries to both obtain justice and return to normal life, and the suspect hopes that the case will be closed.The incident also does not allow Anna to forget about it, as it revived traumatic memories.Delphine Girard's film, which was nominated for an Oscar, is a development of the artist's short production from 2018.

programme.title: Esperando a Dalí
programme.desc: Barcelona, ​​1974, a period of intense opposition to Franco's dictatorship.Brothers Fernando (Ivan Massagué), a chef, and Alberto (Pol López), an activist, must hide from the authorities.They find shelter in Cadaqués, a picturesque seaside village that is also the home of the famous artist Salvador Dalí (Gal Soler).In this setting, the brothers meet Lola (Clara Ponsot), who helps them find work.Fernando, influenced by Dalí's works and his infatuation with women, finds a passion for creating unique dishes.The man's ambitions grow, especially when Jules (José Garcia), Lola's eccentric father, dreams of organizing a dinner for Dalí himself.Despite the difficulties, Fernando creates a culinary masterpiece that inspires a revolution in the world of taste, which leads to the creation of the famous Surreal restaurant.

programme.title: The Pirates! Band of Misfits
programme.desc: A certain inept captain of a pirate ship firmly believes that he will soon become the terror of the seas and oceans.Unfortunately, for now, these ambitious plans have no chance of being implemented, and his subsequent crazy ideas end in failure.The buccaneer, who wants to prove his bravery at all costs, intends to defeat his greatest enemies - Black Bellamy and Cutlass Liz - in the competition for the title of Pirate of the Year.His faithful, although slightly crazy crew will help him achieve his goal.The captain and his companions face quite a challenge.What stands in their way is, among others:young Charles Darwin and the privateers of the cruel Queen Victoria.An adventurous family film directed by Peter Lord, who received his third Oscar nomination for this picture.The plot of the film was taken from a series of books by Gideon Defoe.In the Polish language version, the voices of the characters were provided by, among others:Waldemar Barwiński, Grzegorz Kwiecień, Karol Wróblewski and Izabella Bukowska.

programme.title: Goodbye, Christopher Robin
programme.desc: End of World War I.A.A.Milne (Domhnall Gleeson) moves to the countryside with his family and, finding inspiration in the toys of his son Christopher Robin (Will Tilston), creates a story about the adventures of Winnie the Pooh, who will soon become a children's favorite.However, the quickly achieved international success is not only about profits.The price of A.A.'s fameMilne will suffer not only himself, but also his wife Daphne (Margot Robbie), their son and his caregiver Olive (Kelly Macdonald).The moving film with biographical elements received a BIFA nomination for best supporting actress - Kelly Macdonald.The music composed by Carter Burwell was appreciated by the World Academy of Film Music.

credits.actor: Christopher Robin Aged 6 Months - Stanley Hamlin

programme.title: Ghostlight
programme.desc: Grieving construction worker Dan (Keith Kupferer) joins a local theater group working on a production of Romeo and Juliet.There are changes in his life.

programme.title: Alles Fifty Fifty
programme.desc: Despite the divorce, Marion (Laura Tonke) and Andi (Moritz Bleibtreu) consider themselves exemplary parents of eleven-year-old Milan (Valentin Thatenhorst).They share custody of their son and care for him.So they are surprised when they are called to an interview at the school, during which they learn that the boy is causing a lot of problems.In this situation, they decide to take him on a holiday together to Italy.Marion's new boyfriend, Robin (David Kross), also accompanies them on the trip.Both parents quickly notice that Milan often acts like a spoiled only child, and they come to the conclusion that they need to work on raising him.The time they spend together and their shared efforts make them grow closer again.At the same time, their son falls in love for the first time.

programme.title: Welcome to Marwen
programme.desc: Mark Hogancamp (Steve Carell) is an illustrator, known primarily for his World War II graphics.However, he hides quite an original preference.He is fascinated by women's shoes.At home, she has a large collection of high heels, sandals, flip-flops and many other shoes.His secret is revealed unexpectedly and causes great emotions.He is attacked by a group of neo-Nazis.The injuries are so severe that they result in loss of not only memory, but also the ability to speak and move.His artistic career is ruined.The man starts therapy, hoping to regain his former shape.However, he struggles with enormous trauma and mental problems.He finally manages to find a new passion.He constructs a village in the garden, which he names Marwen.Its inhabitants, the dolls, are modeled on real people from his life.It turns out that the mockup helps him deal with panic attacks.However, he still cannot forget his experiences.Meanwhile, a new neighbor, Nicol (Leslie Mann), moves in next door.The film is inspired by the true story of artist Mark Hogancamp.The town he built is located in Kingston.

programme.title: L'immensita
programme.desc: 1970s. The Borghetti family lives in Rome, is attached to tradition and seems very happy.However, this is only an appearance.Clara (Penélope Cruz) and Felice (Vincenzo Amato) no longer feel love for each other, in fact they don't remember why they decided to get married.The decision to break up, although it seems logical, is unfortunately not easy at all.Clara, repeatedly cheated on by her husband, feels a true bond only with her three children, whose presence provides her with an escape from her overwhelming loneliness.It is for them that she still pretends to be a perfect housewife and tries her best to protect the hearth.Deep down, however, she is not happy.Important cultural and social changes are taking place in the background, which causes the couple's eldest daughter, twelve-year-old Adriana (Luana Giuliani), to become bold and declare that she is a boy.This unexpected announcement leads to a situation in which family relations become even more strained.The film was shown at the Venice International Film Festival.Contains autobiographical threads.Director Emanuele Crialese confessed during the festival that he was inspired by his own childhood.

programme.title: Amrum
programme.desc: Spring 1945. Twelve-year-old Nanning hunts seals and works hard in the fields to help his mother.He faces difficult decisions.

credits.actor: Der alte Mann am Meer - Hark Bohm

programme.title: The Bride!
programme.desc: Chicago, 1930s. At the request of Frankenstein (Christian Bale), researcher Dr. Euphronious (Annette Bening) resurrects for him a woman (Jessie Buckley), a murder victim, pulled out of the grave.An odd couple like Bonny and Clyde quickly attracts trouble and has to flee the city.Detective Jake (Peter Sarsgaard) follows them, with his assistant Myrna (Penelope Cruz) helping him at every step.The revived dead woman and her companion cause chaos wherever they appear.Together they commit robberies and murders, and over time, the two outcasts develop a fiery romance.Mary Shelley, possessed by the voice of the writer, seeks destruction, but at the same time frees herself from the corset of social conventions.An ambitious reinterpretation of a horror classic with elements of Victorian horror and burlesque.

programme.title: Three Billboards Outside Ebbing, Missouri
programme.desc: After months have passed without a culprit in her daughter's murder case, Mildred Hayes makes a bold move, painting three signs leading into her town with a controversial message directed at William Willoughby, the town's revered chief of police. When his second-in-command, Officer Dixon -- an immature mother's boy with a penchant for violence -- gets involved, the battle is only exacerbated.

programme.title: Happy Feet Two
programme.desc: Mambo is the most popular tap dancing penguin in Antarctica and he is madly in love with the beautiful Gloria.The fruit of their love is the smart and resolute Eric.The boy, like his father once, tries to find his place in the world.However, it turns out that he does not share his parent's passion - he cannot and does not want to dance.Soon the little rebel meets the charismatic Sven, who can fly.Obsessed with his new idol, he distances himself more and more from his father.Meanwhile, the entire penguin population begins to face great danger.Mambo, with the help of his faithful friends Ramon and Lovelas, decides to fight to restore the old order in a frosty land... A continuation of the Oscar-winning animation about the adventures of an extraordinary penguin.In the Polish language version, the characters were voiced by, among others: Bartosz Obuchowicz, Sonia Bohosiewicz, Cezary Pazura, Tomasz Kot and Wojciech Mecwaldowski.

programme.title: Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle
programme.desc: Four high school students, as part of a punishment imposed by the principal, have to clean up the cluttered school basement.The collected items include an old console from the 1990s and the Jumanji game.Intrigued, the teenagers decide to activate the device.In this way, they are drawn into the virtual world.They end up in a dangerous jungle, where, as avatars, they are forced to fight for survival.Spencer becomes a brave adventurer, Fridge turns into a zoologist, Bethany becomes a corpulent paleontology professor who knows his way around maps, and Martha becomes a martial arts expert.On their way, they meet a guide who tells them the purpose of the mission.

programme.title: Man on Fire
programme.desc: American John Creasy (Denzel Washington) is a man haunted by nightmares from his past.He is a former assassin who worked for the CIA for many years.Frustrated, he avoids people and seeks solace in alcohol.Creasy comes to Mexico to visit his old friend and colleague, Rayburn (Christopher Walken).The city is currently gripped by a wave of kidnappings for ransom.Rich residents panic and many of them hire security guards to ensure the safety of their children.A friend finds John a job as a bodyguard for ten-year-old Pita Ramos (Dakota Fanning), the daughter of Mexican industrialist Samuel Ramos (Marc Anthony) and his American wife Lisa (Radha Mitchell).At first, Creasy has a hard time coping with the girl's presence.Over time, however, he becomes friends with her.Under its influence, he changes his attitude to life and gives up alcohol.Soon, however, little Pita is kidnapped.The desperate man does everything to save her.

programme.title: Freaky
programme.desc: Millie (Kathryn Newton) lives in a small American town and struggles with numerous problems.He can only count on a pair of loyal friends, Josh (Misha Osherovich) and Nyla (Celeste O'Connor).She is ridiculed by her peers and has just lost her father.To make matters worse, he becomes the target of a psychopath roaming the area, the Blissfield Butcher (Vince Vaughn).The bloody incident has surprising consequences - the girl, stabbed with an antique dagger on a moonlit night, magically switches bodies with her tormentor.In the morning he wakes up as a wanted murderer, and the Butcher can now go hunting in the form of a delicate blonde.Millie has only 24 hours to reverse the spell.Christopher Landon, the creator of "Die Another Day", pays tribute to the classics of horror cinema.He skillfully plays with convention, referring to "Halloween" or "Scream".

programme.title: Bastille Day
programme.desc: On the eve of Bastille Day, an American thief living in Paris, Michael Mason (Richard Madden), steals a bag containing a teddy bear.Not knowing that there is a bomb hidden inside the toy, he takes the money and documents and throws the rest into a trash bin in a crowded Paris metro station.A few seconds later there is a huge explosion.Four people die.City surveillance footage reveals Michael's face.The police, considering him a terrorist, start searching for him.He is stopped by CIA agent Sean Briar (Idris Elba), who is just trying to find his way back to work after returning from Iraq.He brings the suspect to a secret interrogation room.Michael explains the misunderstanding and convinces that someone else is behind the attack.He and Sean have 24 hours to find the real culprits.The film was shot in 2015 and became even more relevant after the attacks in Paris.

programme.title: Y2K: The Millennium Bug
programme.desc: At the end of the 1990s, huge technological problems were predicted related to the arrival of the new millennium and the change of date.This case is a pretext for reflection on the digital revolution.

programme.title: Broke
programme.desc: Former rodeo champion True cannot accept the end of his career.He is surprised by a violent blizzard.He fights for survival.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda 4
programme.desc: Brave Po opens a new chapter in his life - he is to become the spiritual leader of the Valley of Peace.He's trying to get used to his new role.In addition, the voracious bear must find a daredevil who will replace him as the Dragon Warrior.Not everything goes according to plan.This time, China's security is threatened by Chameleon, who wields black magic and can take on any form and take over the abilities of old masters.With the help of a smart vixen and former thief, Zhen, the panda bear must face her.But they need allies to defeat the shape-shifting witch and the sinister army behind her.The time of a merciless fight is inevitably approaching... The voices of the characters include, among others:Marcin Hycnar, Jan Peszek, Wiktor Zborowski and Julia Chatys.

programme.title: Trees, and Other Entanglements
programme.desc: Irene Taylor talks about the extraordinary bond between man and nature, also touching on the topics of mortality and the passage of time.It presents the stories of six people and their deep relationship with trees.

programme.title: Veep 6
programme.desc: Selina Meyer (Julia Louis-Dreyfus) briefly enjoyed the presidency.After losing, the ambitious politician must come to terms with the fact that the leader of the free world and president of the United States is this time not her, but Laura Montez (Andrea Savage).After moving out of the White House, Meyer tries to find his way in his new situation.The sixth installment of the HBO comedy series revealing the behind-the-scenes of American politics.The originator of the series is Oscar nominee Armando Iannucci (The Thick of It, Looped), and the main roles include Golden Globe winner Julia Louis-Dreyfus (The Seinfeld Chronicles), Emmy winner Tony Hale (Hot Goods), Anna Chlumsky (My Girl), Reid Scott (My Guys) and Matt Walsh (The Water Breaks).The production has received numerous awards, including:twelve Emmy statuettes, as well as seven Golden Globe nominations.

programme.desc: African American Billie (Troy Leigh-Anne Johnson) is twenty years old and a tomboy.He comes from a military family and is missing one eye.After serving her prison sentence, she discovers that her separated parents are facing eviction.He decides to prevent this at all costs.The woman decides to rob a bank, but the action ends in failure.As a result, the young criminal takes her client hostage.Pregnant Franny (Grace Van Dien) is eighteen years old and has a head open to crazy ideas.Together they escape and set off on an adventurous journey.At one point, Franny offers Billie an unexpected deal.

programme.desc: Brilliant detective Adrian Monk (Tony Shalhoub) is going through difficult times.The contract to publish his autobiography was canceled, and the coronavirus pandemic intensified his fears and phobias.All this makes the master of deduction start thinking about ending his life and joining his beloved Truda.He is jolted out of his torpor by the tragedy that befalls his stepdaughter Molly (Caitlin McGee).The girl is getting ready to marry journalist Griffin Briggs (Austin Scott).However, her fiancé dies while bungee jumping.Molly is convinced that it was not an accident, but a carefully planned murder.The trail leads to the influential billionaire Rick Eden (James Purefoy).Retired Captain Stottlemeyer (Ted Levine) now works for the rich man as his security chief.Monk is assisted in the investigation by former assistant and now real estate agent Natalie Teeger (Traylor Howard) and Randy Disher (Jason Gray-Stanford), now the New Jersey police commissioner.Continuation of the cult series.

programme.title: Eine Million Minuten
programme.desc: Spouses Vera (Karoline Herfurth) and Wolf (Tom Schilling) Küper, parents of Nina (Pola Friedrichs) and Simon (Piet Levi Busch), have difficulty dividing their time between work and household duties.The bond that united them years ago is weakening.Wolf focuses on his professional career, and Vera, confined to her four walls, is fed up with loneliness and having to replace her children's fathers.The family's world is ruined by the daughter's disastrous medical diagnosis.Wolf recalls that the girl's greatest wish was to spend a million minutes solely on pleasure.The Küpers decide to make her dream come true.Together they set off on a lifelong journey that leads through exotic regions of the world.They get to know new places and foreign cultures, and decide what their future will look like.

programme.title: In short
programme.desc: The year 2019, on the threshold of the pandemic.Single woman Ellen (Laura Tonke) spends New Year's Eve with her friends.No one knows that she is having an affair with Sebastian (Ronald Zehrfeld), Eva's (Antje Traue) husband.Rolf (Nicholas Ofczarek) and Dina (Pegah Ferydoni) make a perfect couple, unlike Mareike (Annette Frier) and Adam (Trystan Pütter).Maya (Katia Fellin) wants children, Natalie (Jasmin Shakeri) cannot decide.Max (Henning Flüsloh) comes into Ellen's life and he would love her if she let him.Years pass.The woman attends various types of celebrations, birthday parties and casual social gatherings.He learns about events in his friends' lives.The sense of community unites and allows everyone to return to everyday life with positive energy.Remake of the Danish film "A Long Story Briefly".

programme.title: Jane Austen Wrecked My Life
programme.desc: Agathe, a shy employee of the Shakespeare \u0026 Co. bookstore.in Paris, dreams of romantic love like in a Jane Austen novel and success as a writer.An invitation to England gives her a chance to change her fate.

programme.title: The Last Showgirl
programme.desc: After thirty years, dancer Shelly Gardner (Pamela Anderson) ends her career.For decades, she performed in a strip revue in Las Vegas, which was inspired by French burlesque.The stage, costumes and music are her passion, for which she sacrificed her family life and relationship with her daughter, Hannah (Billie Lourd).She shared her knowledge and experience with beginner friends Marianne (Brenda Song) and Jodie (Kiernan Shipka).One day, however, producer Eddie (Dave Bautista) announces that the show has been canceled.A devastated Shelly must re-plan her future.A similar fate will befall her friend Annette (Jamie Lee Curtis), a dealer at an arcade.Golden Globe for Pamela Anderson.

programme.title: Industry
programme.desc: The further fate of a group of young bankers in Great Britain.Pierpoint, Harper (Myha'la) and Yasmin (Marisa Abela) live the lavish life they dreamed of as graduates.The financiers are drawn into a tense game when a fintech genius appears on the London scene.Yasmin develops a relationship with Sir Henry Muck (Kit Harington), and Harper is drawn into the web of influence of the mysterious director, Whitney Halberstram (Max Minghella).Under the pressure of money and power, the friendship of young women is put to the test.

programme.title: The Last of Us
programme.sub-title: When You're Lost in the Darkness
programme.desc: Twenty years have passed since the destruction of civilization.Joel Miller (Pedro Pascal) is a battle-hardened survivor.One day, a man is hired to smuggle 14-year-old Ellie (Bella Ramsey) out of the oppressive quarantine zone.What begins as a simple assignment soon becomes a dangerous and heartbreaking journey across the old United States.During this expedition, they both begin to understand that they can only rely on each other to survive.Based on the popular video game of the same title The year 2003. Joel Miller (Pedro Pascal) is just 36 years old.The man works with his brother Tommy (Gabriel Luna) and raises teenage Sarah (Nico Parker) on his own.Their lives go on at a leisurely pace until the day the media begins to provide information about cases of aggression occurring across the country.All services are put on alert.It quickly turns out to be a rapidly spreading epidemic that turns people into beasts.Joel, Tommy and Sarah try to leave the city because it is full of infected people, but they are prevented from doing so by the military that has taken over.One of the soldiers shoots at them, fatally wounding the teenager.20 years have passed.Boston is a closed quarantine zone.Joel is in a relationship with Tess (Anna Torv).They are smugglers who have deals with soldiers and know how to get outside the walls.Meanwhile, there is a group of so-calledFireflies, which fights against the military dictatorship.She wants to take teenage Ellie (Bella Ramsey) out of town.The girl was infected with a fungus that caused an epidemic three weeks earlier, but she is still healthy.When the Fireflies' plan fails, their leader, Marlene (Merle Dandridge), encourages Joel and Tess to get the girl out of town for a handsome reward.

programme.title: Finding Harry: The Craft Behind The Magic

programme.title: Euphoria
programme.desc: The further fate of a group of friends who left school behind and entered adulthood.The action moves forward several years.Rue (Zendaya Coleman) is no longer a lost teenager, but a person involved in the criminal world.He goes to interrogation in connection with smuggling drugs from Mexico.Cassie (Sydney Sweeney) and Maddy's (Alexa Demie) relationship has improved, but old wounds haven't healed at all.The first woman's relationship with Nate (Jacob Elordi) develops, but not towards a happy ending.The remaining characters confront their own choices, addiction and violence.They are looking for redemption and answers to the question about their place in the world.

programme.title: Everest
programme.desc: The year 1996. Rob Hall (Jason Clarke) organizes a commercial expedition to the highest mountain in the world.His brigade includes, among others:Texan Beck Weathers (Josh Brolin) and reporter Jon Krakauer (Michael Kelly).The mountaineers reach the base camp.Over the course of several weeks, they get used to extreme weather conditions and pressure that disregulates the body.Apart from them, other teams are heading to the summit.Hall makes a strategic decision to join Scott Fischer (Jake Gyllenhaal), the head of the Mountain Madness expedition.At the beginning of May, climbers leave the base camp.They struggle with snow storms, bitter cold and lack of oxygen.Extreme conditions put them at the edge of their mental and physical endurance.

programme.title: L'amica geniale
programme.desc: Elena Greco is an elderly woman who tries to solve the mystery of the disappearance of her friend - Raffaella Ceruullo, who was called Lila.The women met in their early youth - in 1950, when they attended primary school.The old woman recalls her early years.The action of the series takes place in dangerous and charming Naples and spans 60 years.The story of their relationship is unconventional, because although Lila was Elena's best friend and confidante, she was also her enemy.The series is an adaptation of the novel by Elena Ferrante Elena continues to study and is aware that fate has been kinder to her than to her best friend, who spends a lot of time every day doing tiring work with her father and brother.However, he sees that Lila excels in many areas.Not only does she seem more capable, intelligent and brave, but also more attractive.Her beauty attracts many boys from the area.Her friends want her, and among them is Marcello Solara - a powerful, dangerous and very handsome boy.Lila, however, is not afraid to reject him.She is also courted by Stefano Carracci, with whom the girl decides to spend New Year's Eve.The boy is the son of the murdered Don Achille, but he decided to distance himself from the terrible events.However, Lila will have unpleasant experiences that night.Meanwhile, Elena, still not accepting her appearance, is involved with an inconspicuous boy named Gino, although her dream has always been Nino Sarratore.

programme.title: Isle of Dogs
programme.desc: The futuristic city of Megasaki in Japan.In the face of a dog flu epidemic, the corrupt Mayor Kobayashi declares a state of emergency and issues a decree under which all dogs are to be quarantined, i.e. sent to an island covered with garbage.The immediate implementation of the order arouses rebellion in twelve-year-old Atari, who thus loses his four-legged friend.However, the boy does not want to give up so easily, he steals a small flying machine and goes to the island to find Ciapek.Once there, he asks for help from a pack of neglected, hungry dogs who are looking for food among the garbage.Together with his new friends, he sets out to find his ward.The film received two Oscar nominations.He was also nominated, among others:to the Golden Globes and BAFTA awards.The animation director is the winner of many awards, for this production he was also honored with the Silver Bear at the Berlinale festival.

programme.title: The Hobbit: The Desolation of Smaug
programme.desc: The hobbit Bilbo (Martin Freeman), Gandalf (Ian McKellen) and the dwarves led by Thorin (Richard Armitage) continue their dangerous journey.The goal of their expedition is to regain Erebor - the kingdom of the dwarves, which is currently occupied by the dragon Smaug (Benedict Cumberbatch).The travelers meet the bear warrior Beorn (Mikael Persbrandt), giant spiders inhabiting Mirkwood, the Wood Elves and their master, King Thranduil (Lee Pace), his son Legolas (Orlando Bloom), and the elf Tauriel (Evangeline Lilly).Thanks to an archer called Bard (Luke Evans), they get to Lake Town.When they reach the Lonely Mountain, they will come face to face with their greatest danger.The second part of the trilogy based on the novel by J.R.R.Tolkien.The film starred, among others: Ian McKellen ("Gods and Monsters"), Martin Freeman ("Fargo", "Sherlock") and Richard Armitage ("Versa", "Epicenter").The film, made on a grand scale, received three Oscar nominations, including for best special effects.

programme.title: Georgie \u0026 Mandy'S First Marriage 2
programme.desc: Young married couple Georgie and Mandy are raising their daughter, learning everyday life in their new role as parents.Each day brings new challenges and fatigue that puts their relationship to the test.

programme.title: Superman
programme.desc: Superman (David Corenswet) stops the president of Boravia from invading Jarhanpur.This brings down the ire of Lex Luthor (Nicholas Hoult), who had an interest in this war.After returning to Metropolis, the superman is defeated by a strongman serving his enemy called the Hammer of Boravia.Luthor also broadcasts a message from Superman's parents to the entire country, urging him to conquer the Earth.Although Lois Lane (Rachel Brosnahan), the girlfriend of superhero Clark Kent's alter ego, assures him that she believes in his goodness, he wants to clear his name.He surrenders to the US authorities, who hand him over to Luthor.The antagonist traps Superman in an alternate reality along with his other enemies.Lois frees her beloved, and when he recovers in the home of his adoptive parents, Martha (Neva Howell) and Jonathan (Pruitt Taylor Vince), he once again fights for peace, with the help of members of the Justice Gang.Meanwhile, Lois is busy exposing Luthor's shenanigans to the public.

programme.title: Neuilly-Poissy
programme.desc: Daniel (Max Boublil) is a successful entrepreneur.He successfully combines running a business with a successful family life.However, when financial irregularities are discovered in his company, he is forced to exchange a luxurious apartment in the city of Neuilly for a cell in the prison in Poissy.From one day to the next, he finds himself in a world whose rules he does not understand.Moreover, he is a Jew and now he will be hanging out with Muslims.However, thanks to his sense of humor and the ability to cope with difficult situations, Daniel tries to adapt to the new reality.

programme.title: Insecure
programme.desc: Issa Dee (Issa Rae), a twenty-something African American woman, lives in Los Angeles.Although she experiences many humiliations, she tries to fight against her chronic lack of self-confidence and her own weaknesses.The lack of money and work problems don't help her at all.Her best friend is Molly (Yvonne Orji), a self-centered lawyer.The series tells the story of the lives of contemporary black women living in the United States.Its originator and producer is the main actress, Issa Rae (First).The artist gained popularity thanks to the website The Misadventures Of Awkward Black Girl and her YouTube channel - so far she has collected over 200,000 likes.followers and 20 million plays.Yvonne Orji (Love That Girl!), Jay Ellis (The Rules of the Game) and Lisa Joyce (It's Never Too Late) will also appear on screen.Critics compare the series to the cult HBO production titled "Girls".

programme.title: 4 from there
programme.desc: Another installment of the adventures of people living in a town straight from a nightmare.It is a terrifying place that traps anyone who crosses its borders.Desperate residents fight to stay alive.

programme.title: Half Man
programme.desc: 1980s. The life of bullied teenage Niall (Mitchell Robertson) turns upside down when the son of his mother's partner, the fierce and unpredictable Ruben (Stuart Campbell), comes to live with them for a while.Even though they are not related by blood, over time they both become inseparable.However, subsequent events make them move away from each other.Three decades later, Ruben (Richard Gadd) shows up uninvited at Niall's (Jamie Bell) wedding.It soon becomes clear why he reconnected with his long-lost brother.A suggestive story about the fragility of male relationships, brotherhood, betrayal, loyalty and violence.

programme.title: House of the Dragon 2
programme.desc: The second series of the production, the events of which precede the action of "Game of Thrones".After the death of Lucerys Velaryon, the son of Queen Rhaenyra Targaryen (Emma D'Arcy), which was caused by his cousin, Aemond Targaryen (Ewan Mitchell), Westeros finds itself on the brink of a bloody civil war.The Green Council supporting King Aegon (Tom Glynn-Carney) and Queen Rhaenyra's Black Council are fighting for influence.Each side claims the Iron Throne.The dynamic development of events also affects the attitude of Rhaenyra's husband, Daemon (Matt Smith), in life.A man who spends a lot of time in Harrenhal Castle, away from his wife, changes a lot.In addition, the demons of his past begin to haunt him.

programme.title: Dope Girls
programme.desc: A widowed single mother, Kate is perceived by those around her as a calm person with conservative views.To provide for his family, he decides to take a surprising step - he opens a nightclub.

programme.title: The Last Duel
programme.desc: France, 14th century.Marquerite de Carrouges (Jodie Comer) accuses Jacques le Gris (Adam Driver) of rape.The man was once friends with her husband, Jean (Matt Damon), from a respectable family.They shed blood together in battles, but later their paths diverged.They were divided by a fight for money and influence.Favored by Count Pierre d'Alencon (Ben Affleck), the less connected, but ambitious and educated Jacques won further honors.However, it was Jean who married a beautiful, proud and intelligent woman who also caught the attention of his companion.Now the knight must defend her and his honor.He challenges le Gris, who denies the allegations, to a duel.Not only pride and justice are at stake - if de Carrouges dies, his wife will also die.The spectacular story with stylish photos by Dariusz Wolski is based on facts.The last court duel took place in France in 1386.

programme.title: Berlin Nobody
programme.desc: American social psychologist Ben Monroe (Eric Bana) moves to Berlin after breaking up with his wife.He gained fame for his research on sects, including a religious group operating in the German capital, and is currently preparing to write another book on this subject.One day, his partner Nina (Sylvia Hoeks) and his old friend, policeman Max Aumann (Stephan Kampwirth), take him to a crime scene where it seems that several people have been ritually committed suicide.Soon, Ben is visited by his 16-year-old daughter, Mazzy (Sadie Sink).She is seduced by a local boy, Martin (Jonas Dassler).He tells her that he is involved in the activities of a pro-ecological non-governmental organization run by the charismatic Hilma (Sophie Rois).The girl allows herself to be drawn into this group, unaware that it is a sect that has chosen her as a victim.When Ben discovers how much danger Mazzy is in, he races against time to save her.The film's script is based on the 2015 novel by Nicholas Hogg."Tokyo", but the setting was moved to Berlin.

programme.title: Noah: Chosen by God
programme.desc: The distant past.Due to the wickedness of Cain's descendants, the inhabitants of large cities, the world is falling into decline.Only representatives of the House of Set still carry out the will of the Creator.One night, former warrior and healer Noah (Russell Crowe) has a terrible dream.He sees it as a gigantic flood that destroys the world.Along with his wife Naameh (Jennifer Connelly) and three sons, he visits his grandfather Methuselah (Anthony Hopkins) to seek his advice.He discovers that his dream is actually a prediction of the great flood.Noah becomes aware that he has been chosen by the Creator to save the lives of innocents.With the help of stone giants called Guardians, he begins work on an ark that will be a shelter for various animal species.Years later, when the specter of disaster becomes more and more real, the huge ship is almost ready.Then the descendant of the first murderer, the self-proclaimed ruler Tubal-kain (Ray Winstone), demands a place in the ark for himself and his subjects.

programme.title: Neuilly-Poissy

programme.title: The Munsters
programme.desc: Transylvania.Dr. Henry Augustus Wolfgang (Richard Brake) and his not very bright assistant Floop (Jorge Garcia) want to create the perfect man from the dead bodies of geniuses of the past century.By mistake, instead of the brain of a great scientist, they implant the organ of his twin brother, a bad comedian, into the creature they created.This is how Herman Potwornicki (Jeff Daniel Phillips) is created.When Wolfgang decides to show it to the world on TV, he is devastated.However, the uncouth, joking giant attracts the attention of the unmarried and undead Lily (Sheri Moon), who is fed up with unsuccessful dates.The girl finds Herman and they quickly become a couple.The future son-in-law, although he gained fame and won Lily's heart, does not like her father, a vampire and a refined count (Daniel Roebuck).However, the lovers get married.Due to the intrigues of the count's cunning ex-wife, Zoya Krupp (Catherine Schell) and her assistant, the werewolf Lester (Tomas Boykin), they lose their palace and fortune.They decide to go to America, where Herman intends to conquer Hollywood.They start a new life in a ruined house in the suburbs.A colorful production referring to the series from the 1960s. Director Rob Zombie is his big fan.

programme.title: The Pig Who Cried Werewolf
programme.desc: A bad wolf lives next to three little pigs, Heimlich, Dieter and Chef.The first of them discovers that under the influence of the moon he transforms into a woman who is obsessed with catching pigs.

programme.title: The Hobbit: The Battle of the Five Armies
programme.desc: Thorin Oakenshield, the hobbit Bilbo and their companions recover the treasure of Erebor, which was guarded by Smaug.The leader of a company of dwarves cannot resist wealth.He sacrifices friendship and honor to gloat over him.To make matters worse, armies of elves and humans appear at the Lonely Mountain, intending to take over some of the dwarves' gold as compensation for the losses caused by the dragon.For years, the beast ravaged the area and destroyed their settlements.Proud Thorin does not intend to give in to the demands of the newcomers.To resolve conflicts, Bilbo secretly gives the elves the archjewel.They use the treasure as an argument in negotiations with Thorin, and the hobbit becomes a traitor to the dwarves.While representatives of different races are arguing with each other and trying to force concessions, the army of their common enemy is approaching the dwarves' headquarters.In the face of danger, the conflicting parties must unite.

programme.title: Minecraft
programme.desc: Garrett (Jason Momoa), Henry (Sebastian Hansen), Natalie (Emma Myers) and Dawn (Danielle Brooks) constantly struggle with problems.The lives of these four change when a magical portal pulls them into a strange land full of cubes.The Overworld turns out to be a place where everything is possible thanks to imagination, which, however, is sometimes difficult to control.Once there, Garrett, Henry, Natalie and Dawn meet Steve (Jack Black), who was trapped on this side of the portal many years earlier.Together with him, they decide to defend the unusual land from evil creatures called piglins.For them to succeed, they will have to show courage and discover qualities that will make it easier for them to find their place in the real world later.A hit production for the whole family, inspired by the popular game.

programme.title: American Pickers

programme.title: Shipping Wars
programme.sub-title: Jessica signs up to move a half-ton steampunk robot in a single day. Meanwhile, Todd and Tamera realise that moonshine stills and porcelain plates don't mix well
programme.desc: You won't hear the phrase \"free shipping\" uttered in this real-life series. It follows heavy-duty movers as they battle for the chance to transport items that traditional carriers won't touch, from bulky loads such as a Civil War cannon to bizarre items like a water buffalo. The competition begins each day when thousands of shipments are put up for auction online, and the truckers who make the lowest bids get the loads. It's a high-stakes game, figuring out what shipments are worth the time and money to move them, but the bottom line is these haulers -- rookies and seasoned vets alike -- will deliver anything if the price is right.

When he sees a vehicle he wants, whether it's at an auto auction or at a roadside diner, Koker does all he can to acquire it. programme.title: Shipping Wars
programme.sub-title: Independent shippers compete with each other to transport unconventional items that other carriers find unfeasible to ship
programme.desc: You won't hear the phrase \"free shipping\" uttered in this real-life series. It follows heavy-duty movers as they battle for the chance to transport items that traditional carriers won't touch, from bulky loads such as a Civil War cannon to bizarre items like a water buffalo. The competition begins each day when thousands of shipments are put up for auction online, and the truckers who make the lowest bids get the loads. It's a high-stakes game, figuring out what shipments are worth the time and money to move them, but the bottom line is these haulers -- rookies and seasoned vets alike -- will deliver anything if the price is right.

credits.actor: Marc Springer,Jennifer Brennan,Jarrett Joyce,Christopher Hanna,Robbie Welsh,Dusty Davie,Todd Sturgis,Tamera Sturgis,Jessica Samko

programme.title: Leepu \u0026 Pitbull
programme.sub-title: The guys have to transform a 1987 Oldsmobile Cutlass into a high-powered dragster. The stakes are high as the customer challenges Pitbull to a quarter-mile race
programme.desc: This reality series teams up master mechanic Steve \"Pitbull\" Trimboli with Leepu, a renowned car designer from Bangladesh. Together, their expertise has created a lucrative business. Each episode features a customer with a small budget, an interesting story, and a heap of metal that's special to him or her. Leepu and Pitbull's task is to turn the clunker into a cool custom automobile. The guys sometimes have a difference of opinion on ways to complete each job, but they ultimately make each customer happy, which is key to running a successful business.

programme.title: Jang Youngsil: The Greatest Scientist Of Joseon
programme.desc: The drama is the first 'historic science' drama that has been produced in Korea. This drama depicts the successful life story of the scientist Jang Youngsil that contributed to the development and accomplishment of Joseon's science during the 15th century. In particular, the drama emphasizes his accomplishment through showing the restrictions and difficulties he experienced due to his social class as a slave. Moreover, the drama aims to depict Jang Youngsil as the role model of 'Korea's youth of the 21st century' through displaying his scientific accomplishments. The drama also expects to stimulate scientific curiosity amongst audiences and help them easily understand the fundamental principles of science by utilizing various data and scientific videos.

programme.desc: In Onjeong Market, located in Onjeong, a town some distance away from Seoul, the area is buzzing with change as apartment complexes are built and plans for subway extensions and new town developments are announced. Across a single street stand a principled general hospital, Gongmyeongjeongdae Clinic, and traditional Korean clinic, Yangji Barun Clinic. The two families who run these places have been bitter enemies for years, bound by a long standing grudge from an incident in the past. Even the smallest matters turn into big fights, making them the most famous rival families in Onjeong. This is a family growth drama about these two families as they unravel their long held misunderstandings, heal their wounds, learn to love one another, and are reborn as one family.

programme.desc: In Onjeong Market, located in Onjeong, a town some distance away from Seoul, the area is buzzing with change as apartment complexes are built and plans for subway extensions and new town developments are announced. This is a family growth drama about these two families as they unravel their long held misunderstandings, heal their wounds, learn to love one another, and are reborn as one family.

programme.desc: Across Africa 97% of black rhinos have been killed for their horns. In 1997 the species was declared officially extinct in Zambia. But a small, dedicated team are fighting to keep them safe. This is the frontline of conservation – it doesn’t get any tougher.

programme.title: Crave
programme.desc: Warning: do not watch Crave on an empty stomach. Because we’ll have you craving a creamy scoop of ice cream bedded on a crispy waffle. Or really, really needing to crunch into juicy fried chicken right now. Hosted by Charlotte Mei, the runner-up of Eat List Star, Crave finds out what gets celebrities salivating – roti prata, roast meats, sushi, satay, salted egg ice cream, buah keluak, and even an English-style big breakfast! Our celebrities’ cravings know no bounds, and anything from local to Japanese to Mediterranean fare is fair game – as long as they crave it. And there’s a little special by Charlotte. On every show, she will cook a dish – guaranteed to make you crave for it.

programme.title: The Flood 1: First Pulse
programme.desc: The Okavango Delta is a water phenomenon on the sands of the Kalahari Desert.Every year, heavy rains transform the barren region into a true oasis teeming with life.In a two-part documentary, director Brad Bestelink introduced the inhabitants of this unique place on Earth.The camera lens included both small dragonflies and giant elephants.Spectacular photos were taken from various perspectives - from the ground, from a bird's eye view and from the water depths.Scenes of exciting hunting intertwine with the idyll of life in a fertile land.Masters of survival The story begins while waiting for rain.On a sun-baked, dry and barren land, there is a fight for survival.Wild cats - a cheetah and a leopard - show off their skills.She stands out for her speed, he is able to lure his prey into an ambush.They both turn out to be effective in hunting, for example, impala.As the rain pours down, the region undergoes an almost magical transformation.The water attracts herds of various animals.Among them are African buffalos, which are hunted by lions.Viewers will also learn about the adventures of a longclaw who tries alone to ensure the safety of three chicks.Scenes from the lives of various species form a story about a complex ecosystem.

programme.title: One Strange Rock
programme.desc: A story about the creation and history of the planet, the laws governing it, its shape, the richness of flora and fauna, threats to the natural environment, natural wonders and surprising relationships.Actor Will Smith and people who have had the opportunity to spend time in space will talk about this extraordinary place in the universe.Accounts from astronauts including Mae Jemison, Mike Massimino, Leland Melvin and Chris Austin Hadfield will provide a completely new perspective on Earth.Director Darren Aronofsky and his film crew visited 45 countries and six continents.The photos were taken in, among others, the Arctic, the Himalayas, India and during the annual festival in Tarragona, Spain.Materials recorded on board the International Space Station were also used.In the following episodes, viewers will learn how oxygen is produced, the protective layers of the Blue Planet and the entire sequence of events that led to the creation of life.The topic of death, colonization, destruction, the search for alien forms and human intellect will also be discussed.

programme.title: Big Cat Planet
programme.desc: Big cats, symbols of wild nature, today face the challenge of survival in a changing world.More and more often, their paths cross with people, leading to inevitable conflicts.On this journey, we learn about their unique adaptive skills: cheetahs use cars for hunting, jaguars dive near boats, and lions appear more and more often on the streets of Indian cities.This fresh look shows the cunning of predators that are still among the most dangerous inhabitants of nature.

programme.title: Thailand's Wild Cats
programme.desc: The ancient kingdom is hidden deep in the jungle and is the last refuge for wild cats in Thailand.Its inhabitants include three females: a clouded leopard, a female tarai and a tigress.

programme.title: Animal fights
programme.desc: Unique shots of spectacular clashes involving the largest and most dangerous predators on our planet.This extraordinary series also features animals that, although seemingly gentle, are surprisingly belligerent when threatened.We will see how brave they are, among others.lions, wolves, hippos and crocodiles.We will see to what extent the result of the duel depends on strength and weapons such as teeth or claws, and to what extent it depends on good tactics.The program used materials recorded by the best nature photographers, as well as films made by amateurs who witnessed fierce fights in the animal world.

programme.title: United States of Animals: Compilation Season 1

programme.title: Animal Genius
programme.desc: Biologist Liz Bonnin has been revealing the secrets of the fauna kingdom for years.In this film, he observes animals that are very good at fighting predators, even though they do not have sharp claws and fangs.Their survival is related to skills such as communication and cooperation.It turns out that nature still hides many secrets from us.The observed animals surprise scientists who make new discoveries.This time they will learn patents for survival, including:in Africa and Mexico.There is strength in a herd. Charming meerkats have already been the heroines of many documentaries and TV series.Curious mammals living in the Kalahari Desert are exposed to attacks by predators.They can inform each other about various threats.Their characteristic sound signals are crucial.Viewers will also watch the battle between Matabele warrior ants and termites.Unusual insects can provide first aid to injured companions.In Mexico, Liz Bonnin will observe sea turtles.The small reptiles face a dangerous journey to the ocean.They move towards the water together, increasing their chances of survival.These scenes show that in nature, it is not only the strongest who survive, but also the best connected.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation Special Report
programme.desc: There have been many cases in history where pilots stopped trusting the readings of the devices on board.The cockpit then became a place of dramatic struggles.The events that took place during the demonstration of the latest product of the French aviation industry will be recalled.A routine training flight of one of the most modern aircraft in the world also had a tragic ending.The machine fell into the Mediterranean Sea.The program also includes a behind-the-scenes look at the Airbus cruise accident that disappeared from radar over the Atlantic.

programme.title: Life Below Zero: First Alaskans: Season 3
programme.desc: A story about the indigenous people of Alaska who have lived according to the rhythm of nature for centuries.Each season has its own rules here.Tig Strassburg wants to give seven children the knowledge and skills to survive in this hostile place.Young Apassingoks hunt for the entire local community.Joel Jacko combines tradition with modernity.Jody Potts-Joseph, on the other hand, begins a new chapter of life in her home village.Marvin Agnot survives on what he catches in the ocean or finds on the coast.John and Teresa Pingayak are also training the next generation.

programme.title: Pacific Rim
programme.desc: Long ago, legions of monstrous creatures called Kaiju arose from the sea, bringing with them all-consuming war. To fight the Kaiju, mankind developed giant robots called Jaegers, designed to be piloted by two humans locked together in a neural bridge. However, even the Jaegers are not enough to defeat the Kaiju, and humanity is on the verge of defeat. Mankind's last hope now lies with a washed-up ex-pilot (Charlie Hunnam), an untested trainee (Rinko Kikuchi) and an old, obsolete Jaeger.

When the eruption of Mount Vesuvius rains lava and ash down on the city, Milo races to save her before it's too late.

programme.title: The Girl in the Pool
programme.desc: A man's life collapses when his mistress is found dead in his pool. Terrified of the consequences and desperate to protect his family, he conceals the truth, triggering a chaotic night that threatens to unravel his perfect life.

programme.title: The Dark Tower
programme.desc: Roland Deschain (Idris Elba), the last Gunslinger, is locked in an eternal battle with Walter O'Dim (Matthew McConaughey), also known as the Man in Black. The Gunslinger must prevent the Man in Black from toppling the Dark Tower, the key that holds the universe together. With the fate of worlds at stake, two men collide in the ultimate battle between good and evil.

programme.title: Hotel Artemis
programme.desc: As rioting rocks Los Angeles in the year 2028, disgruntled thieves make their way to Hotel Artemis -- a 13-story, members-only hospital for criminals. It's operated by the Nurse, a no-nonsense, high-tech healer who already has her hands full of a French assassin, an arms dealer and an injured cop. As the violence of the night continues, the Nurse must decide whether to break her own rules and confront what she's worked so hard to avoid.

programme.title: Barron's Cove
programme.desc: A man with a violent past kidnaps the boy he holds responsible for his son's death. As he grows closer to uncovering the truth, he's left to wonder whether his pursuers are really seeking to protect the boy, or merely the secrets he keeps.

programme.title: Enemy at the Gates
programme.desc: Vassili is a young Russian sharpshooter who becomes a legend when a savvy political officer makes him the hero of his propaganda campaign. Their friendship is threatened when both men fall in love with a beautiful female soldier. As the battle for the city rages, Vassili faces the ultimate challenge when the Nazi command dispatches its most elite marksman to hunt down and kill the man who has become the hope of all Russia.

programme.title: Kinky Boots
programme.desc: After his father's demise, Charlie Price inherits the family business, a shoe factory in Northampton, England. He is not interested in shoes, and the factory is in such dire financial straits that he must lay off 15 employees. However, a fortuitous encounter with a transvestite cabaret singer inspires Charlie to save the factory from closure by producing erotic footwear, much to the chagrin of the workers.

programme.title: Couples Therapy
programme.desc: "Couples Therapy" is a documentary series following couples as they seek the help of psychoanalyst Dr. Orna Guralnik with their troubled relationships; coming off their previous success with the award-winning documentary "Weiner", executive producers Josh Kriegman and Elyse Steinberg are collaborating on the unscripted series that will feature real couples from New York City and its surrounding areas; the show strives to present the participants and the therapy process with empathy and not sensationalism as viewers track the couples' progress with Dr. Guralnik through each episode.

programme.title: The Chi
programme.desc: The South Side of Chicago carries daily danger, and the smallest and simplest of decisions can have life or death consequences for the residents. Life continues as the kids prep for school and their parents shuffle off to work. The young adults of the area are trying to scrape a living for themselves, while the elders sit on their front porches and observe the goings on. The South Side has the potential to crush dreams, and this coming-of-age series focuses on Kevin, a preteen who embraces the normal rites of childhood, Brandon, who makes a leap of faith to succeed in love and life with Jerrika, Emmett, who seeks guidance from his mother, and Ronnie, who is a drifter struggling to be loved. All of them are linked together by sheer coincidence as they seek redemption.

programme.title: The Last Duel
programme.desc: Jean de Carrouges is a respected knight known for his bravery and skill on the battlefield. Jacques Le Gris is a squire whose intelligence and eloquence makes him one of the most admired nobles in court. When Le Gris viciously assaults Carrouges' wife, she steps forward to accuse her attacker, an act of bravery and defiance that puts her life in jeopardy. The ensuing trial by combat, a grueling duel to the death, places the fate of all three in God's hands.

programme.title: Lilies Not for Me
programme.desc: In the 1920s England, a gay novelist and his psychiatric nurse form an unlikely friendship over a series of doctor-prescribed "dates." Through their conversations, he tells her the story of his relationship with an old friend which spiraled out of control when they turned to a risky procedure to cure themselves of their forbidden feelings for one another.

programme.title: Scary Movie V
programme.desc: Much bizarre activity follows after a husband and wife bring their newborn infant home from the hospital. When they realize that a demon is stalking their family, they consult paranormal specialists and install numerous cameras to drive out the pesky spirit. Movies that are spoofed in the familiar format include the "Paranormal Activity" franchise, "Mama," "Sinister," "Evil Dead," "Inception," "Black Swan" and "Rise of the Planet of the Apes.".

programme.title: The Gambler
programme.desc: Literature professor Jim Bennett (Mark Wahlberg) leads a secret life as a high-stakes gambler. Always a risk-taker, Bennett bets it all when he borrows from a gangster and offers his own life as collateral. Staying one step ahead, he pits his creditor against the operator of an illicit gambling ring while garnering the attention of Frank (John Goodman), a paternalistic loan shark. As his relationship with a student (Brie Larson) deepens, Bennett must risk everything for a second chance.

programme.title: Molly's Game
programme.desc: The true story of Molly Bloom, a beautiful, young, Olympic-class skier who ran the world's most exclusive high-stakes poker game for a decade before being arrested in the middle of the night by 17 FBI agents wielding automatic weapons. Her players included Hollywood royalty, sports stars, business titans and finally, unbeknown to her, the Russian mob. Her only ally was her criminal defense lawyer Charlie Jaffey, who learned there was much more to Molly than the tabloids led people to believe.

programme.title: The Friend
programme.desc: New York City writer Iris finds her comfortable, solitary life thrown into disarray after her closest friend and mentor bequeaths her a Great Dane named Apollo. The huge dog immediately creates practical problems for Iris, from furniture destruction to eviction notices, as well as more existential ones. Yet as Iris finds herself unexpectedly bonding with Apollo, she begins to come to terms with her past, and her own creative inner life.

programme.desc: 90% of Koreans use the Internet, almost all of them do it every day.There they follow vloggers who play online games, or muk-bang, i.e. people eating in front of the camera.Online users also adopt virtual children or see the world from a cat's perspective.However, greater activity on the Internet is related to the real, deepening loneliness of Koreans.The heroine of the episode will be BJ Levi, who reports her life on the Internet - she is Muk-bang and she makes money from it.In Korean, the word "family" means people who eat together.It is generally accepted that no one should eat a meal alone.On the other hand, nowadays more and more people live away from their families, so BJe provide them with company.The best of them can earn up to $9-10,000 a month, which is two or three times more than corporate employees.The most popular ones gain the status of celebrities.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: Martyna Wojciechowska visits Tanzania.The traveler will look at the tradition according to which a woman can marry another woman.However, this is not related to homosexuality, which is banned in this country.Sexual acts between people of the same sex are punishable by imprisonment.The first case of a relationship between two women in Tanzania was recorded in 1927.For the Kuria tribe, children, especially boys, are the most valuable.So when a woman is, for example, infertile, she must marry another woman to give her children.As in the case of male-female relationships, the partner is paid in cows.Depending on the amount of wealth owned, there may be several wives.Relationships between women constitute 10-15% of all marriages.They live together, do housework and raise children together.

programme.title: The Extraordinary States of Procopius
programme.desc: Marcin Prokop will go on a spontaneous journey around America in a program full of humor.During his journey across the United States, which lasts over a month, the journalist will cover thousands of kilometers.Viewers will have the opportunity to see the alleys of the largest Chinese district in the US, find themselves behind the walls of the most famous prison, Alcatraz, and look out the window of the tallest skyscraper in San Francisco.The host will stop at the world's largest stop for giant trucks, visit a hippie town and visit a unique restaurant connected to a laundry.The audience will be able to feast their eyes on amazing landscapes, unique national parks and wonderful waterfalls In this episode, Marcin will go to San Francisco.The presenter will cross the Golden Gate Bridge, where Agent 007 fought a murderous fight with Max Zorin in the film about the adventures of James Bond.He will also visit the colorful Castro district, where Harvey Milk once fought for gay rights.Then he will go to the Haight-Ashbury district, the cradle of hippies, where Marcin will undergo a surprising metamorphosis.A visit to this city would not be complete without a trip to Lombard Street, known as the most twisted street in the world.After a walk through the city streets, the presenter will take us to the most liberal beach in California and show us the famous Alcatraz prison, where Al Capone ended his gangster career.

programme.desc: Martyna Wojciechowska reaches Ghana, where she takes part in an important event - a funeral.In this country, the social status of the deceased is determined by the way of mourning, the number of mourners and the shape of the coffin.Veronica is a professional crier.He supports himself and his sons from his salary.It offers clients, among others:crying with falling to the ground, convulsions or squirrel crying.The traveler also talks to Paa Joe - a world-famous coffin artist.His work was purchased, for example, by Jimmy Carter, the president of the United States.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: Martyna Wojciechowska is going to Austria.There he meets an extraordinary gymnast, Jennifer Bricker-Bauer, who... was born without legs.Shortly after being born, she was abandoned in the hospital.Her adoptive parents gave her a great will to fight and also taught her not to use words such as "I can't", "I can't do it" or "I can't".She reached for the dreams that were within her reach and achieved success.Now he infects others with his optimism and motivates them.The story of the heroine of the third episode is a great example that the best scripts are written by life, and insurmountable barriers simply do not exist.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: There are still places where education remains a luxury that many children can only dream of.These include Bangladesh - a small country in South Asia, one of the most densely populated and poorest in the world.An area twice as small as Poland is inhabited by as many as 170 million people.At the same time, 20% of the population lives below the poverty line.Obtaining an education gives you a chance to improve your financial situation.Unfortunately, the monsoons that hit Bangladesh every year cut off 1/4 of its area from the rest of the world, including schools.To help thousands of children, squares, libraries and educational centers were created... on boats.He studies there, among others:Rabija, the youngest heroine of Martyna Wojciechowska's program so far.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: Martyna Wojciechowska goes to Prague, Czech Republic, where she plans to talk about... sex.The heroine of the episode is Vladana Augsten, a professional who treats sexuality through touch.She is a certified sexual assistant for disabled people, one of eleven in the Czech Republic.In Switzerland, Belgium, the Netherlands and Germany, this profession is widely known, but in this post-communist country it appeared for the first time only five years ago.Organizations training people involved in it also received funding from the state.One of them is the Freya Foundation.The sexuality of disabled people remains a taboo.Parents not only avoid the topic, but even make it difficult for their children to establish closer relationships, wanting to spare them pain and disappointment.The goal of Vladana and other sexual assistants is to support clients in their pursuit of independence.

programme.title: Man, Woman, Wild

programme.title: My Baby Gone
programme.desc: Pregnant Emily bonds quickly with her pregnant neighbor Kelly, but Kelly is faking it and plans to steal Emily's baby.

programme.title: Pretty Little Stalker
programme.desc: A self help writer and her family become the target of a troubled girl. AKA The Danger of Positive Thinking

programme.title: The 39 Steps
programme.desc: A man in London tries to help a counter-espionage agent, but when the agent is killed and the man stands accused, he must go on the run to save himself and stop a spy ring that is trying to steal top-secret information.

programme.desc: wedotv Movies UK delivers a diverse selection of free-to-air cinema, specializing in a broad range of genres from contemporary blockbusters and action thrillers to heartwarming dramas and classic films.

programme.title: The Ten Commandments Part 1 The Laws of God
programme.desc: A grand retelling of the epic story of Moses. Escaping death, a Hebrew infant is raised in a royal household to become a prince. Upon discovery of his true heritage, Moses embarks on a personal quest to reclaim his destiny as the leader and liberator of the Hebrew people.

programme.title: The Ten Commandments Part 2 The Laws of Man
programme.desc: After narrowly avoiding death, a Hebrew baby is adopted into a royal family and grows up to be a prince. Once he learns the truth about his origins, Moses begins his journey to fulfill his destiny as the leader who will free the Hebrew slaves in Egypt.

programme.title: #No Joke
programme.desc: A musician's journey to create a song with some of the biggest stars in the industry. Along the way, he faces up to his painful past, while giving viewers a deep personal insight into the issue of bullying.

programme.title: Starting Up Love
programme.desc: When workaholic Jillian gets a note that her long-lost, wealthy uncle has passed away, she finds he’s left her his beautiful mountainside cabin – and a family she never knew existed. Jillian’s plan is to sell the cabin as soon as possible and move on, but when she meets handsome caretaker Liam, he makes her an offer she can’t refuse. Sparks fly as they work together to transform the cabin into a holiday resort. When business doesn’t go as planned and she almost loses her newfound family, Jillian needs to make a decision. Will she give up everything for the love she never saw coming?

programme.title: 4 Wedding Planners
programme.desc: After Lily rejects her boyfriend's marriage proposal, she returns home to Hawaii where she must help out with her mother's wedding planning business.

programme.title: A Time to Dance
programme.desc: A Time to Dance follows the bittersweet story of longtime couple John and Abby, whose separation is postponed when they find out their daughter is getting married. Determined not to spoil their daughter's big moment, they secretly put their plans on hold only to have the wedding planning process draw them back together.

programme.title: Triple Cross
programme.desc: During WW2, convicted bank robber Eddie Chapman becomes a triple agent working for both the British and the Germans.

programme.title: Sommersby
programme.desc: A farmer returns home from the Civil War, but his wife begins to suspect that the man is an impostor.

programme.title: Twist Of Fate
programme.desc: Grieving over the untimely loss of his family and in a dissociative state, an aimlessly-wandering Jewish man is rescued by another family who help him find his way back to happiness again.

programme.title: The Wrong Patient
programme.desc: Dr. Jen Richards, a successful plastic surgeon, becomes entangled in the web of a narcissist patient whose path to perfection threatens to destroy Jen and her family.

programme.title: Bonds will be Broken
programme.desc: When her sister Nina is seduced by a mysterious self-improvement cult, Anna decides to go undercover at the cult's annual retreat to save her sister from the sinister cult leader.

programme.title: Legend
programme.desc: A young man must stop the Lord of Darkness from destroying daylight and marrying the woman he loves.
